description: Internal registry for mapping FluentControl command ids and aliases to canonical protocol IR operations. Each fluentcontrol_name carries fluentcontrol_name_source and confidence so UI titles are traceable.

InteriorLightOffStatement.passthrough_reason: System interior deck-light side effect; preserve XML until light control is modeled in protocol IR. Runtime equivalent: RuntimeController.InteriorLight(false).

InteriorLightOnStatement.passthrough_reason: System interior deck-light side effect; preserve XML until light control is modeled in protocol IR. Runtime equivalent: RuntimeController.InteriorLight(true).

LoopGroupDataV1.manual_step: Loop over wells or repeated commands

LeaveStatement.passthrough_reason: FluentControl loop/control-flow exit statement; not currently represented as an editable protocol IR operation.

VariableMapping.passthrough_reason: FluentControl variable metadata object referenced by statements; not an executable robot command.

Int32.passthrough_reason: Typed integer literal used inside FluentControl statement data; not an executable robot command.

String.passthrough_reason: Typed string literal used inside FluentControl statement data; not an executable robot command.

ExecuteApplicationStatement.passthrough_reason: External application execution side effect; preserve XML until external runtime hooks are modeled in protocol IR.

ExecuteVbScriptStatement.passthrough_reason: VBScript runtime hook; preserve XML until script execution side effects are modeled in protocol IR.

ApplicationDriverMacro.passthrough_reason: Application-driver macro call; preserve XML until driver macro semantics are modeled in protocol IR.

MoveAxisCommandScriptStatement.passthrough_reason: Low-level axis movement statement; preserve XML until hardware-driver motion semantics are modeled in protocol IR.

StartMoveCommandScriptStatement.passthrough_reason: Low-level asynchronous hardware movement statement; preserve XML until hardware-driver motion semantics are modeled in protocol IR.

WaitForAsyncResponseScriptStatement.passthrough_reason: Waits for an asynchronous hardware-driver response; preserve XML until driver response semantics are modeled in protocol IR.

TeGioSetPWMOutputStatement.passthrough_reason: Sets a TeGIO hardware PWM output pin; preserve XML and require physical pin verification before instrument use.

LegacyDriverMacro.passthrough_reason: Legacy-driver macro call; preserve XML until driver macro semantics are modeled in protocol IR.

RUPWorktableStatement.passthrough_reason: TouchTools worktable-bound runtime prompt (RUPWorktableStatement) with labware binding and CustomDetailImageFilePath; treated as prompt_user for XSCR roundtrip and inventory gates.

RUPStandardStatement.passthrough_reason: Standalone TouchTools runtime user prompt (RUPStandardStatement) carrying MessageText/SelectedImagePath; treated as a user prompt so post-compile re-inspection and roundtrip recognize it as prompt_user.

GenerateReportStatement.passthrough_reason: Report-generation side effect; preserve XML until reporting is modeled in protocol IR.

RaiseErrorStatement.passthrough_reason: FluentControl error/abort statement; preserve XML until explicit error handling is modeled in protocol IR.

LihaDetectLiquidScriptCommand.passthrough_reason: LiHa liquid detection is a hardware sensing operation not yet represented in protocol IR.

CgaDropFingersScriptCommand.passthrough_reason: CGA finger-release action is a gripper hardware operation not yet represented in protocol IR.

ImportVariableStatement.passthrough_reason: Variable import statement observed in the full export; preserve source XML until variable import/export is modeled in protocol IR.

ExportVariableStatement.passthrough_reason: Variable export statement observed in the full export; preserve source XML until variable import/export is modeled in protocol IR.

EndScriptStatement.passthrough_reason: Script termination statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until explicit end-script semantics are modeled in protocol IR.

WaitStatement.passthrough_reason: Timing wait statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until wait timing is modeled in protocol IR.

DelayStatement.passthrough_reason: Delay statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until delay timing is modeled in protocol IR.

StartTimerStatement.passthrough_reason: Timer start statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until timer control is modeled in protocol IR.

WaitForTimerStatement.passthrough_reason: Timer wait statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until timer control is modeled in protocol IR.

LoadWorklistStatementDataV4.passthrough_reason: Worklist load statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until this Worklist v4 schema is modeled.

WorklistImportStatementDataV2.passthrough_reason: Worklist import statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until this Worklist v2 schema is modeled.

ExecuteWorklistStatementDataV1.passthrough_reason: Worklist execution statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until this Worklist v1 schema is modeled.

LihaEmptyTipsScriptCommandDataV4.passthrough_reason: LiHa empty-tip-content operation observed in the full export; preserve XML until the operation is modeled.

LihaFlushScriptCommandDataV3.passthrough_reason: LiHa flush operation observed in the full export; preserve XML until this command schema is modeled.

LihaMoveArmScriptCommandDataV3.passthrough_reason: LiHa arm movement observed in the full export; preserve XML until hardware-motion semantics are modeled.

LihaSampleTransferSmartCommand.passthrough_reason: LiHa smart sample-transfer command observed in the full export; preserve XML until smart-command expansion is modeled.

LihaReagentDistributionSmartCommand.passthrough_reason: LiHa smart reagent-distribution command observed in the full export; preserve XML until smart-command expansion is modeled.

LihaRetractPiercingNeedleScriptCommand.passthrough_reason: LiHa piercing-needle movement observed in the full export; preserve XML until this hardware command is modeled.

LihaInlineFilterCheckScriptCommandDataV1.passthrough_reason: LiHa inline filter check observed in the full export; preserve XML until this hardware check is modeled.

LihaClldSelfTestScriptCommandDataV1.passthrough_reason: LiHa cLLD self-test command observed in the full export; preserve XML until this hardware check is modeled.

LihaSetTipsBackScriptCommandDataV1.passthrough_reason: LiHa set-tips-back command observed in the full export; preserve XML until this command schema is modeled.

RUPIfStatement.passthrough_reason: TouchTools RUP conditional statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until RUP flow control is modeled.

RUPSelectWellsStatement.passthrough_reason: TouchTools well-selection statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until selection UI is modeled.

RUPVerificationStatement.passthrough_reason: TouchTools verification statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until this RUP statement is modeled.

RUPGetFileStatement.passthrough_reason: TouchTools file-pick statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until file selection is modeled.

RUPReportStatement.passthrough_reason: TouchTools report statement observed in the full export; preserve XML until RUP reporting is modeled.

fluentcontrol_name_source.fluentcontrol_control_bar: Exact Control Bar command title observed in FluentControl UI.
fluentcontrol_name_source.fluentcontrol_script_palette: Script Editor palette / grouped statement label.
fluentcontrol_name_source.source_script_observed: Observed in decompiled FluentControl project scripts.
fluentcontrol_name_source.connector_display_name: Connector capability DisplayName from FluentControl install metadata.
fluentcontrol_name_source.manual_curated: Human-curated descriptive title; not necessarily the exact UI string.
fluentcontrol_name_source.ir_operation_label: Derived from canonical IR operation or structural metadata label.

confidence.high: Strong documentary evidence (source scripts, connector metadata).
